sentences.text: The RBI’s current UCB rule allows a UCB, at its option, to provide borrowers a choice to switch to a fixed rate at the time of reset, as per its Board-approved policy.
The bank’s retail loan policy says that, at reset of a floating-rate loan, the Bank may, at its option, offer the borrower a choice to switch to a fixed rate as per its Board-approved policy.
On that point, the policy is consistent with the current UCB rule rather than in conflict with it.
The current UCB rule also requires transparent disclosure of applicable switching charges in the sanction letter and when charges are revised, if such charges apply.
